STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE — DISTRACTOR)
Solicitation No.: SYN-J-0010
Title: Base Landscaping and Athletic Field Turf Management

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall provide turf management and landscaping services
for base athletic fields and common grounds, including mowing,
fertilization, and irrigation system maintenance.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Mow and edge athletic fields on a weekly schedule during the
    growing season.
2.2 Apply fertilization and pest-control treatments per an approved
    seasonal plan.
2.3 Inspect and repair irrigation system components as needed.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Base athletic fields and common grounds, notional installation.
